_comment: psi_watch/psi_alert use the standard, widely-published PSI convention (< 0.10 = no significant shift, 0.10-0.25 = moderate/watch, >= 0.25 = significant/alert -- see e.g. Siddiqi, Credit Risk Scorecards). default_rate_swing_pp=3.0 is this repo's own chosen operating threshold, not a value derived from data -- tune it once a real baseline and a real production window are both available.
